cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Yes, I'll look after your dog during the kitchen repairs. Bring him over after his walk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needs to stay overnight too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Absolutely. Stay in my guest room; you can handle breakfast while I sleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can stay, but his six o'clock walk is your job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll organise it: lead by the door, your alarm at five thirty. You won't have to plan a thing.

mechanism: A agrees to dog care but uses qualified scheduling and handling instructions to reinterpret the agreement as managing B labour rather than performing it.
confusable: Ordinary delegation might be explicit; here each yes promises B relief then changes who does the work.
comparison: Sofa alternative supervises two carriers; dog alternative organises the owner into continuing overnight care.
seedUse: Repairs, overnight stay and six oclock walk derive from D23-b; S03 adds precise feeding/walking order to make expertise the favourable reinterpretation.
